verdict.rationale: The only automation evidence is an API filter for chats "created by scheduled prompts", which implies Limitless can run user-defined prompts automatically on a schedule. That is a time-based trigger, not general event-driven rules. Missing for 10: rules triggered by events (e.g., new lifelog, keyword, or meeting end), configurable actions beyond generating a chat, any first-party docs describing how scheduled prompts are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
